articles.summary: CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - EverQuote, Inc. (Nasdaq: EVER), a leading provider of growth solutions for property and casualty insurance providers, today published a white paper titled “ Agentic Barbarians at the Carriers’ Gates - Personal AI Agents and the Future of PC Insurance Distribution ” examining the impact of Personal AI Agents on the PC insurance sector today and the opportunities for carriers to adapt and thrive in the era of agentic shopping.
